heading: Pets I’ve loved & looked after
intro: A few of the dogs and cats I’ve had the joy of walking, feeding, and spoiling over the years.
note: Caring for children is every bit as central to what I do — I just keep the little ones’ photos private out of respect for their families. So here, it’s the wagging tails and whiskers I get to show off.

items.name: The Rottweiler
items.note: A big gentle soul — garden afternoons, snow days, and long neighbourhood walks.
items.photoAlt: A black-and-tan Rottweiler, out in the garden and in the snow

items.name: The brown-and-white springer
items.note: Rarely seen without a bone, and friends with everyone at the park.
items.photoAlt: A brown-and-white springer spaniel holding a bone

items.name: The black-and-white springer
items.note: Brings you the ball, then brings it right back again.
items.photoAlt: A black-and-white springer spaniel carrying a green ball

items.name: The dachshund crew
items.note: A whole houseful of long-haired dachshunds — garden patrol, bench naps, and one very fine cabbage patch.
items.photoAlt: Long-haired dachshunds in the garden and on a bench

items.name: The wire-haired dachshund
items.note: Scruffy, sweet, and a devoted napper in any patch of sun.
items.photoAlt: A wire-haired dachshund standing on a striped rug

items.name: The Dobermans
items.note: A handsome pair — walked side by side, always in step.
items.photoAlt: Two black-and-tan Dobermans standing side by side on a walk
